task: Define and visualize the Starlight Character Foundry v2 workflow without imitating Marvel intellectual property.
surface: Operational documentation diagram and character-system handoff
audience: Starlight founder, character makers, runtime owners, independent reviewers, and future agent swarms
first_read: Runtime truth moves through founder-gated representation, divergence, collision, story proof, independent QA, and a receipt-bearing release.

references.label: SIS 2026-08-17 Taste Constitution
references.reason: Sets the active foundation reset, anti-defaults, black-and-white territory gate, and founder approval boundary.

references.label: Marvel Studios visual development retrospective
references.reason: Informs the story-first and cross-discipline visual-development method, not a copied look.

references.label: Marvel X-Men '97 character design interview
references.reason: Informs silhouette, acting, function, source essence, and production collaboration.

references.label: Starlight Character Foundry v2
references.reason: Provides the exact G0-G10 operating sequence represented by the diagram.

keep: Oxidized-red only for intervention and founder gates
Exact operational labels and visible rollback loop
avoid: Cosmic Queen, robot, superhero, star, or constellation defaults
Black glass, cyan-gold glow, card grids, and decorative complexity
direction.signature: Bounded intelligence: the system makes power, limits, handoffs, evidence, and human gates visible.
system: Two process lanes: derive and prove
Deep navy for authority, oxidized red for intervention, warm white for the civic field
Sentence-case stage labels with restrained editorial typography
Accessible title and description embedded in the SVG
Receipt-bearing authority chain in the footer

asset_quality.why_premium: The source is deterministic, original, semantically exact, and governed by the active SIS taste constitution; final premium status remains unclaimed until the export is visually inspected.

artifacts.notes: PowerShell XML parsing passed and the root reports viewBox 0 0 1600 900. Raster/export inspection is pending because machine preflight returned HOLD.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier C deterministic vector diagram with owned provenance and no fake product UI.

checks.name: xml-validation
checks.evidence: The SVG parses as XML with a 1600 by 900 viewBox and contains accessible title and description nodes.

checks.name: rights-and-originality
checks.evidence: The diagram contains no Marvel characters, logos, costumes, names, or copied composition; Marvel informs method only.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: pp preflight --workload browser-qa returned HOLD on 2026-08-27: 7951 MB free versus 8192 MB required and 33 task runtimes versus a budget of 8.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: No browser, raster, responsive, contrast, or in-context inspection was run after the performance gate returned HOLD.

score.notes: Not scored. The 30-point premium score requires visual inspection; source-level correctness alone is insufficient.

known_risks: Font metrics, label collision, arrow routing, contrast, and small-text readability have not been visually inspected.
The SVG must not be used as a release-grade visual until the blocked inspection checks pass and the evidence record is superseded.
